report.summary: Patient P-D001 (age 58, dual Medicaid/Medicare coverage, home tract 17031260300) requested food-access options. Four community food resources were found near the patient's census tract. Eligibility: community fridge is open access ("take what you need"); Saturday Market Pantry is for Cook County residents; Northwest Side Food Pantry requires no ID and offers fresh produce Wednesdays; medically tailored meals require a referral form to determine qualification. No patient identifiers were shared beyond what is needed for care coordination.
